title: Evaluation of a Patient Decision Aid for Emergency Department Initiated Buprenorphine
official: CTN-0156: Pilot Development and Evaluation of a Patient Decision Aid for Emergency Department Initiated Buprenorphine
summary: This study aims to develop and pilot test a patient decision aid (PtDA) for emergency department (ED)-initiated buprenorphine treatment for opioid use disorder (OUD). The PtDA will be evaluated for acceptability, impact on patient knowledge, decisional conflict, and buprenorphine uptake compared to treatment as usual (TAU).

interventions.name: Patient Decision Aid for Opioid Use Disorder

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥18
* DSM-5 criteria for moderate-to-severe OUD
* Speaks and reads English
* Not currently prescribed MOUD
* Post-ED discharge patients with access to video/email

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Prisoners
